The main takeaway from our work is that
hybrid control is a promising approach for solving the global attitude tracking control problem.

, in the absence of a global output, the hybrid control approach is the most promising way to design controllers that can simultaneously avoid the unwinding problem, be robust to measurement noise, and be able to globally stabilize the system.
, in the presence of measurement noise, a hybrid controller can be designed to be more robust than its continuous and discontinuous counterparts.
